name: Sewer Pipe Trap
disable: DC 32 Thievery check (expert) on the floor panels before the plate falls away

items.name: Filth Fall
items.text:
Trigger Pressure is placed on the floor tiles

---
Effect The metal plate above gives way, unleashing a torrent of sewage and flesh-eating worms on everyone within 10 feet of the pressure plate. Anyone hit by the filth must attempt a DC 32 Fortitude save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature becomes Sickened 1 and takes 2d12 piercing damage.

Failure The creature is Sickened 2 and takes 4d12 piercing damage.

Critical Failure The creature is Sickened 4 and takes 4d12 piercing damage plus 2d12 persistent,piercing damage.

text: Pressure-sensitive panels in the floor connects to a metal plate holding a number of sewer pipes shut in the ceiling.
